title: Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.14717v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo.   The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across

translated_title: 共享集解码器中的局部增益与固定分配集损失
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14717v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：查询-关系删除可以改善编辑后的槽位，但会降低包含该槽位的预测集的效用。我们在两个相关的ResNet-50 DETR系列检查点中，使用每个检查点710个配对图像-关系单元的记录性、选择条件性证据来研究这种张力。主要比较从选定的目标删除中减去一个匹配的主动对照，该对照在不同的记录接收者处删除相同的领导源。因此，这是一种复合对比，而非同一接收者的安慰剂。目标减去对照的对比在两个检查点中均表现为局部正效应和固定分配负效应。相反符号模式出现在DETR单元的302/710和DINO单元的460/710中。重新匹配后，相应计数为285/710和433/710。重新匹配和原生选择吸收了足够多的平均损失，使DETR区间跨越零，而DINO区间仍为负，因此持续性跨越。
tldr: 该论文通过配对实验发现，在共享集解码器中，查询-关系删除在局部层面改善编辑槽位，但在固定分配下导致预测集整体损失，且不同模型（DETR与DINO）在重新匹配后表现出不同的持续性差异。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that query-relation deletion in shared set decoders yields local gains but fixed-assignment set losses, with DETR and DINO models showing divergent persistence after rematching.
